Exits non-zero on any failure.\nset -eu\ncd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/..\"\ngo vet ./...\ngo test ./...\n=== cmd/csvstat/main.go\n// Command csvstat profiles the columns of a CSV file.\npackage main\n\nimport (\n\t\"os\"\n\n\t\"csvstat/internal/cli\"\n)\n\nfunc main() {\n\tos.Exit(cli.Run(os.Args[1:], os.Stdout, os.Stderr))\n}\n=== internal/cli/args.go\npackage cli\n\nimport (\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"flag\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n)\n\n// Options is the parsed command line. ColumnSet, FreqSet and TopSet record\n// whether the option was given, so an empty value is distinguishable from an\n// absent option.\ntype Options struct {\n\tColumn    string\n\tColumnSet bool\n\tFreq      string\n\tFreqSet   bool\n\tTop       int\n\tTopSet    bool\n\tFile      string\n}\n\nvar errRepeated = errors.New(\"option given more than once\")\n\n// stringOption is a flag value that records presence and refuses repetition.\ntype stringOption struct {\n\tvalue *string\n\tset   *bool\n}\n\nfunc (o *stringOption) String() string {\n\tif o == nil || o.value == nil {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\treturn *o.value\n}\n\nfunc (o *stringOption) Set(v string) error {\n\tif *o.set {\n\t\treturn errRepeated\n\t}\n\t*o.value = v\n\t*o.set = true\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// intOption is a flag value holding a decimal integer that refuses repetition.\ntype intOption struct {\n\tvalue *int\n\tset   *bool\n}\n\nfunc (o *intOption) String() string {\n\tif o == nil || o.value == nil {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\treturn strconv.Itoa(*o.value)\n}\n\nfunc (o *intOption) Set(v string) error {\n\tif *o.set {\n\t\treturn errRepeated\n\t}\n\tn, err := strconv.Atoi(v)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%q is not a decimal integer\", v)\n\t}\n\t*o.value = n\n\t*o.set = true\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ParseArgs parses options followed by exactly one file argument. Parsing stops\n// at the first non-option argument, which must be the file, so any later\n// argument, including an option, is an error.\nfunc ParseArgs(args []string) (Options, error) {\n\tvar opts Options\n\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"csvstat\", flag.ContinueOnError)\n\tfs.SetOutput(io.Discard)\n\tfs.Var(&stringOption{&opts.Column, &opts.ColumnSet}, \"column\", \"\")\n\tfs.Var(&stringOption{&opts.Freq, &opts.FreqSet}, \"freq\", \"\")\n\tfs.Var(&intOption{&opts.Top, &opts.TopSet}, \"top\", \"\")\n\tif err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {\n\t\treturn Options{}, err\n\t}\n\n\trest := fs.Args()\n\tswitch len(rest) {\n\tcase 0:\n\t\treturn Options{}, errors.New(\"missing file argument\")\n\tcase 1:\n\t\topts.File = rest[0]\n\t\treturn opts, nil\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"unexpected argument %q after file or extra file\", rest[1])\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/cli/args_test.go\npackage cli\n\nimport \"testing\"\n\nfunc TestParseArgsFileOnly(t *testing.T) {\n\topts, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"data.csv\"})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ParseArgs: unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif want := (Options{File: \"data.csv\"}); opts != want {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Options = %+v, want %+v\", opts, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsColumn(t *testing.T) {\n\topts, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"--column\", \"name\", \"data.csv\"})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ParseArgs: unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif want := (Options{Column: \"name\", ColumnSet: true, File: \"data.csv\"}); opts != want {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Options = %+v, want %+v\", opts, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsFreqTop(t *testing.T) {\n\topts, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"--freq\", \"name\", \"--top\", \"3\", \"data.csv\"})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ParseArgs: unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\twant := Options{Freq: \"name\", FreqSet: true, Top: 3, TopSet: true, File: \"data.csv\"}\n\tif opts != want {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Options = %+v, want %+v\", opts, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsEmptyValueIsSet(t *testing.T) {\n\topts, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"--column\", \"\", \"data.csv\"})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ParseArgs: unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif !opts.ColumnSet || opts.Column != \"\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Options = %+v, want ColumnSet with empty Column\", opts)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsMissingFile(t *testing.T) {\n\tif _, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"--column\", \"name\"}); err == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"ParseArgs with no file: got nil error, want error\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsExtraFile(t *testing.T) {\n\tif _, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"a.csv\", \"b.csv\"}); err == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"ParseArgs with two files: got nil error, want error\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsUnknownOption(t *testing.T) {\n\tif _, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"--frobnicate\", \"data.csv\"}); err == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"ParseArgs with unknown option: got nil error, want error\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsMissingValue(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, args := range [][]string{{\"--top\"}, {\"--freq\"}, {\"--top\", \"data.csv\"}} {\n\t\tif _, err := ParseArgs(args); err == nil {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"ParseArgs(%q): got nil error, want error\", args)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsOptionsAfterFile(t *testing.T) {\n\tif _, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"data.csv\", \"--column\", \"name\"}); err == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"ParseArgs with option after file: got nil error, want error\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsRepeatedOption(t *testing.T) {\n\tif _, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"--column\", \"a\", \"--column\", \"b\", \"data.csv\"}); err == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"ParseArgs with repeated --column: got nil error, want error\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestParseArgsTopMustBeDecimal(t *testing.T) {\n\tif _, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"--top\", \"0x10\", \"data.csv\"}); err == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"ParseArgs with --top 0x10: got nil error, want error\")\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/cli/cli.go\npackage cli\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/csv\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n\t\"os\"\n\n\t\"csvstat/internal/csvdata\"\n)\n\n// Exit codes. Only cmd/csvstat calls os.Exit with the value Run returns.\nconst (\n\texitOK          = 0\n\texitOperational = 1\n\texitUsage       = 2\n\texitRejected    = 3\n)\n\n// Run executes csvstat with args, which excludes the program name, and returns\n// the process exit code. Stdout is written only on success; diagnostics go to\n// stderr. Only cmd/csvstat calls os.Exit with this value.\nfunc Run(args []string, _ io.Writer, stderr io.Writer) int {\n\topts, err := ParseArgs(args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"csvstat: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn exitUsage\n\t}\n\n\tf, err := os.Open(opts.File)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"csvstat: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn exitOperational\n\t}\n\tdefer f.Close()\n\n\ttable, err := csvdata.Read(f)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"csvstat: %s: %v\\n\", opts.File, err)\n\t\treturn readFailureExit(err)\n\t}\n\tcsvdata.Trim(table)\n\tif err := csvdata.Validate(table); err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"csvstat: %s: %v\\n\", opts.File, err)\n\t\treturn exitRejected\n\t}\n\treturn exitOK\n}\n\n// readFailureExit maps a Read error to an exit code: a CSV syntax error is\n// rejected input, while any other failure to read the file is operational.\nfunc readFailureExit(err error) int {\n\tvar parseErr *csv.ParseError\n\tif errors.As(err, &parseErr) {\n\t\treturn exitRejected\n\t}\n\treturn exitOperational\n}\n=== internal/cli/cli_test.go\npackage cli\n\nimport (\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\n// runWith writes content to a temporary file and runs the command on it.\nfunc runWith(t *testing.T, content string) (code int, stdout *bytes.Buffer, stderr *bytes.Buffer) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tpath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"input.csv\")\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0o600); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"write input: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn runArgs(t, path)\n}\n\nfunc runArgs(t *testing.T, args ...string) (code int, stdout *bytes.Buffer, stderr *bytes.Buffer) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tstdout, stderr = &bytes.Buffer{}, &bytes.Buffer{}\n\tcode = Run(args, stdout, stderr)\n\treturn code, stdout, stderr\n}\n\nfunc TestRunValidFileExitsZero(t *testing.T) {\n\tcode, _, _ := runWith(t, \"a,b\\n1,2\\n\")\n\tif code != exitOK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitOK)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunHeaderOnlyFileExitsZero(t *testing.T) {\n\tcode, _, _ := runWith(t, \"a,b\\n\")\n\tif code != exitOK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitOK)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunRejectedInputExitsThreeWithEmptyStdout(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string]string{\n\t\t\"empty file\":        \"\",\n\t\t\"blank lines only\":  \"\\n\\n\\n\",\n\t\t\"empty header name\": \"id,,name\\n1,x,y\\n\",\n\t\t\"repeated header\":   \"id,name,id\\n1,x,2\\n\",\n\t\t\"ragged record\":     \"a,b\\n1,2\\n3,4,5\\n6,7\\n\",\n\t\t\"bare quote\":        \"a,b\\n1\\\"x,2\\n\",\n\t}\n\tfor name, content := range cases {\n\t\tt.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\tcode, stdout, _ := runWith(t, content)\n\t\t\tif code != exitRejected {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitRejected)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stdout has %d bytes, want none\", stdout.Len())\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunUsageErrorExitsTwoWithEmptyStdout(t *testing.T) {\n\tpath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"input.csv\")\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(\"a,b\\n1,2\\n\"), 0o600); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"write input: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tcases := map[string][]string{\n\t\t\"no arguments\":      {},\n\t\t\"option after file\": {path, \"--column\", \"a\"},\n\t\t\"unknown option\":    {\"--frobnicate\", path},\n\t}\n\tfor name, args := range cases {\n\t\tt.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\tcode, stdout, _ := runArgs(t, args...)\n\t\t\tif code != exitUsage {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitUsage)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stdout has %d bytes, want none\", stdout.Len())\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunMissingFileExitsOne(t *testing.T) {\n\tmissing := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"absent.csv\")\n\tcode, stdout, _ := runArgs(t, missing)\n\tif code != exitOperational {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitOperational)\n\t}\n\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stdout has %d bytes, want none\", stdout.Len())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunValidFormsAreNotUsageErrors(t *testing.T) {\n\tpath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"input.csv\")\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(\"a,b\\n1,2\\n\"), 0o600); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"write input: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tforms := [][]string{\n\t\t{path},\n\t\t{\"--column\", \"a\", path},\n\t\t{\"--freq\", \"a\", path},\n\t\t{\"--freq\", \"a\", \"--top\", \"3\", path},\n\t}\n\tfor _, form := range forms {\n\t\tif code, _, _ := runArgs(t, form...); code == exitUsage {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run(%q) exit code = %d, want non-usage\", form, code)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/cli/doc.go\n// Package cli parses arguments, dispatches commands, maps failures to exit\n// codes, and writes diagnostics to standard error.\npackage cli\n=== internal/csvdata/doc.go\n// Package csvdata reads CSV input, trims fields, recognizes null spellings, and\n// rejects malformed input.\npackage csvdata\n=== internal/csvdata/null.go\npackage csvdata\n\nimport \"strings\"\n\n// IsNull reports whether value, already trimmed of leading and trailing spaces,\n// is a null spelling: empty, or NA, N/A or NULL ignoring case. No other token\n// is null.\nfunc IsNull(value string) bool {\n\treturn value == \"\" ||\n\t\tstrings.EqualFold(value, \"NA\") ||\n\t\tstrings.EqualFold(value, \"N/A\") ||\n\t\tstrings.EqualFold(value, \"NULL\")\n}\n=== internal/csvdata/null_test.go\npackage csvdata\n\nimport \"testing\"\n\nfunc TestIsNullEmpty(t *testing.T) {\n\tif !IsNull(\"\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(`IsNull(\"\") = false, want true`)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestIsNullSpellings(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, value := range []string{\"NA\", \"na\", \"Na\", \"N/A\", \"n/a\", \"NULL\", \"null\", \"Null\"} {\n\t\tif !IsNull(value) {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"IsNull(%q) = false, want true\", value)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestIsNullNonNullValues(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, value := range []string{\"0\", \"false\", \"NAN\", \"N/B\", \"NULLS\", \"NA1\", \"N A\", \"nil\", \"none\", \"-\"} {\n\t\tif IsNull(value) {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"IsNull(%q) = true, want false\", value)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestQuotedEmptyFieldIsNull(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n\\\"\\\",x\\n\")\n\n\tif !IsNull(table.Records[0].Fields[0]) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"quoted empty field %q is not null\", table.Records[0].Fields[0])\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestSpacesOnlyFieldIsNull(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n   ,x\\n\")\n\tTrim(table)\n\n\tif !IsNull(table.Records[0].Fields[0]) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"spaces-only field %q is not null after trimming\", table.Records[0].Fields[0])\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/csvdata/read.go\npackage csvdata\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/csv\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n)\n\n// Record is one data record and the 1-based source line on which it starts.\ntype Record struct {\n\tLine   int\n\tFields []string\n}\n\n// Table is a parsed CSV input: the header record and the data records after it.\ntype Table struct {\n\tHeader  []string\n\tRecords []Record\n}\n\n// Read parses r as RFC 4180 CSV. The first record is the header and every later\n// record is a data record. Values are returned as parsed, untrimmed. Input with\n// no record returns a nil Header and no error; Validate rejects it.\nfunc Read(r io.Reader) (*Table, error) {\n\tcr := csv.NewReader(r)\n\tcr.FieldsPerRecord = -1\n\tcr.LazyQuotes = false\n\n\tvar t Table\n\theader, err := cr.Read()\n\tif err == io.EOF {\n\t\treturn &t, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"read csv: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tt.Header = header\n\n\tfor {\n\t\tfields, err := cr.Read()\n\t\tif err == io.EOF {\n\t\t\treturn &t, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"read csv: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tline, _ := cr.FieldPos(0)\n\t\tt.Records = append(t.Records, Record{Line: line, Fields: fields})\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/csvdata/read_test.go\npackage csvdata\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/csv\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\nfunc mustRead(t *testing.T, input string) *Table {\n\tt.Helper()\n\ttable, err := Read(strings.NewReader(input))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Read(%q): unexpected error: %v\", input, err)\n\t}\n\treturn table\n}\n\nfunc TestReadHeaderAndRecords(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"name,qty\\nwidget,2\\ngadget,5\\n\")\n\n\tif want := []string{\"name\", \"qty\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Header, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Header = %q, want %q\", table.Header, want)\n\t}\n\tgot := make([][]string, len(table.Records))\n\tfor i, rec := range table.Records {\n\t\tgot[i] = rec.Fields\n\t}\n\twant := [][]string{{\"widget\", \"2\"}, {\"gadget\", \"5\"}}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"record fields = %q, want %q\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadQuotedComma(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"name,note\\n\\\"Smith, J\\\",ok\\n\")\n\n\tif len(table.Records) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %d records, want 1\", len(table.Records))\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"Smith, J\", \"ok\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Records[0].Fields, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Fields = %q, want %q\", table.Records[0].Fields, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadTrailingNewline(t *testing.T) {\n\twithNewline := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n1,2\\n\")\n\twithoutNewline := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n1,2\")\n\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(withNewline, withoutNewline) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"with newline = %+v, without = %+v; want equal\", withNewline, withoutNewline)\n\t}\n\tif len(withNewline.Records) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %d records, want 1\", len(withNewline.Records))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadRecordLineNumbers(t *testing.T) {\n\t// The first data record starts on line 2 and spans lines 2-3 through the\n\t// quoted newline; the next record starts on line 4.\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n1,\\\"multi\\nline\\\"\\n3,4\\n\")\n\n\tlines := make([]int, len(table.Records))\n\tfor i, rec := range table.Records {\n\t\tlines[i] = rec.Line\n\t}\n\tif want := []int{2, 4}; !reflect.DeepEqual(lines, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"record lines = %v, want %v\", lines, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadHeaderOnly(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, input := range []string{\"a,b\\n\", \"a,b\"} {\n\t\ttable := mustRead(t, input)\n\t\tif want := []string{\"a\", \"b\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Header, want) {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Read(%q) Header = %q, want %q\", input, table.Header, want)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif len(table.Records) != 0 {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Read(%q) got %d records, want 0\", input, len(table.Records))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadNoRecords(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, input := range []string{\"\", \"\\n\\n\\n\"} {\n\t\ttable := mustRead(t, input)\n\t\tif table.Header != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Read(%q) Header = %q, want nil\", input, table.Header)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif len(table.Records) != 0 {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Read(%q) got %d records, want 0\", input, len(table.Records))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadBareQuoteReportsParseError(t *testing.T) {\n\t_, err := Read(strings.NewReader(\"a,b\\n1\\\"x,2\\n\"))\n\n\tvar parseErr *csv.ParseError\n\tif !errors.As(err, &parseErr) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Read error = %v, want a *csv.ParseError\", err)\n\t}\n\tif parseErr.Line != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ParseError.Line = %d, want 2\", parseErr.Line)\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/csvdata/trim.go\npackage csvdata\n\nimport \"strings\"\n\n// Trim removes leading and trailing spaces (U+0020) from every header name and\n// every record field, in place. Other whitespace and interior spaces are kept.\n// Line numbers and field counts are unchanged.\nfunc Trim(t *Table) {\n\tfor i, name := range t.Header {\n\t\tt.Header[i] = strings.Trim(name, \" \")\n\t}\n\tfor r := range t.Records {\n\t\tfields := t.Records[r].Fields\n\t\tfor i, value := range fields {\n\t\t\tfields[i] = strings.Trim(value, \" \")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/csvdata/trim_test.go\npackage csvdata\n\nimport (\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\nfunc TestTrimHeaderNames(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"  name ,  qty\\n1,2\\n\")\n\tTrim(table)\n\n\tif want := []string{\"name\", \"qty\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Header, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Header = %q, want %q\", table.Header, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestTrimValues(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n  Globex  , Acme Corp \\n\")\n\tTrim(table)\n\n\tif want := []string{\"Globex\", \"Acme Corp\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Records[0].Fields, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Fields = %q, want %q\", table.Records[0].Fields, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestTrimQuotedPadding(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"a\\n\\\"  Acme, Inc.  \\\"\\n\")\n\tTrim(table)\n\n\tif want := []string{\"Acme, Inc.\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Records[0].Fields, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Fields = %q, want %q\", table.Records[0].Fields, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestTrimOnlySpaces(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Only U+0020 is trimmed: the leading and trailing tabs stay, and the\n\t// interior space stays.\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"  \\ta b\\t  \\n \\tv w\\t \\n\")\n\tTrim(table)\n\n\tif want := []string{\"\\ta b\\t\"}; ColumnSet, FreqSet and TopSet record\n// whether the option was given, so an empty value is distinguishable from an\n// absent option.\ntype Options struct {\n\tColumn    string\n\tColumnSet bool\n\tFreq      string\n\tFreqSet   bool\n\tTop       int\n\tTopSet    bool\n\tFile      string\n}\n\nvar errRepeated = errors.New(\"option given more than once\")\n\n// stringOption is a flag value that records presence and refuses repetition.\ntype stringOption struct {\n\tvalue *string\n\tset   *bool\n}\n\nfunc (o *stringOption) String() string {\n\tif o == nil || o.value == nil {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\treturn *o.value\n}\n\nfunc (o *stringOption) Set(v string) error {\n\tif *o.set {\n\t\treturn errRepeated\n\t}\n\t*o.value = v\n\t*o.set = true\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// intOption is a flag value holding a decimal integer that refuses repetition.\ntype intOption struct {\n\tvalue *int\n\tset   *bool\n}\n\nfunc (o *intOption) String() string {\n\tif o == nil || o.value == nil {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\treturn strconv.Itoa(*o.value)\n}\n\nfunc (o *intOption) Set(v string) error {\n\tif *o.set {\n\t\treturn errRepeated\n\t}\n\tn, err := strconv.Atoi(v)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%q is not a decimal integer\", v)\n\t}\n\t*o.value = n\n\t*o.set = true\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ParseArgs parses options followed by exactly one file argument. Parsing stops\n// at the first non-option argument, which must be the file, so any later\n// argument, including an option, is an error.\nfunc ParseArgs(args []string) (Options, error) {\n\tvar opts Options\n\tfs := flag.NewFlagSet(\"csvstat\", flag.ContinueOnError)\n\tfs.SetOutput(io.Discard)\n\tfs.Var(&stringOption{&opts.Column, &opts.ColumnSet}, \"column\", \"\")\n\tfs.Var(&stringOption{&opts.Freq, &opts.FreqSet}, \"freq\", \"\")\n\tfs.Var(&intOption{&opts.Top, &opts.TopSet}, \"top\", \"\")\n\tif err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {\n\t\treturn Options{}, err\n\t}\n\n\trest := fs.Args()\n\tswitch len(rest) {\n\tcase 0:\n\t\treturn Options{}, errors.New(\"missing file argument\")\n\tcase 1:\n\t\topts.File = rest[0]\n\t\treturn opts, nil\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn Options{}, fmt.Errorf(\"unexpected argument %q after file or extra file\", rest[1])\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/cli/args_test.go\npackage cli\n\nimport \"testing\"\n\nfunc TestParseArgsFileOnly(t *testing.T) {\n\topts, err := ParseArgs([]string{\"data.csv\"})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ParseArgs: unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif want := (Options{File: \"data.csv\"}); Only cmd/csvstat calls os.Exit with the value Run returns.\nconst (\n\texitOK          = 0\n\texitOperational = 1\n\texitUsage       = 2\n\texitRejected    = 3\n)\n\n// Run executes csvstat with args, which excludes the program name, and returns\n// the process exit code. Only cmd/csvstat calls os.Exit with this value.\nfunc Run(args []string, _ io.Writer, stderr io.Writer) int {\n\topts, err := ParseArgs(args)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"csvstat: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn exitUsage\n\t}\n\n\tf, err := os.Open(opts.File)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"csvstat: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\treturn exitOperational\n\t}\n\tdefer f.Close()\n\n\ttable, err := csvdata.Read(f)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"csvstat: %s: %v\\n\", opts.File, err)\n\t\treturn readFailureExit(err)\n\t}\n\tcsvdata.Trim(table)\n\tif err := csvdata.Validate(table); err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(stderr, \"csvstat: %s: %v\\n\", opts.File, err)\n\t\treturn exitRejected\n\t}\n\treturn exitOK\n}\n\n// readFailureExit maps a Read error to an exit code: a CSV syntax error is\n// rejected input, while any other failure to read the file is operational.\nfunc readFailureExit(err error) int {\n\tvar parseErr *csv.ParseError\n\tif errors.As(err, &parseErr) {\n\t\treturn exitRejected\n\t}\n\treturn exitOperational\n}\n=== internal/cli/cli_test.go\npackage cli\n\nimport (\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\n// runWith writes content to a temporary file and runs the command on it.\nfunc runWith(t *testing.T, content string) (code int, stdout *bytes.Buffer, stderr *bytes.Buffer) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tpath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"input.csv\")\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0o600); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"write input: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn runArgs(t, path)\n}\n\nfunc runArgs(t *testing.T, args ...string) (code int, stdout *bytes.Buffer, stderr *bytes.Buffer) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tstdout, stderr = &bytes.Buffer{}, &bytes.Buffer{}\n\tcode = Run(args, stdout, stderr)\n\treturn code, stdout, stderr\n}\n\nfunc TestRunValidFileExitsZero(t *testing.T) {\n\tcode, _, _ := runWith(t, \"a,b\\n1,2\\n\")\n\tif code != exitOK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitOK)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunHeaderOnlyFileExitsZero(t *testing.T) {\n\tcode, _, _ := runWith(t, \"a,b\\n\")\n\tif code != exitOK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitOK)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunRejectedInputExitsThreeWithEmptyStdout(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string]string{\n\t\t\"empty file\":        \"\",\n\t\t\"blank lines only\":  \"\\n\\n\\n\",\n\t\t\"empty header name\": \"id,,name\\n1,x,y\\n\",\n\t\t\"repeated header\":   \"id,name,id\\n1,x,2\\n\",\n\t\t\"ragged record\":     \"a,b\\n1,2\\n3,4,5\\n6,7\\n\",\n\t\t\"bare quote\":        \"a,b\\n1\\\"x,2\\n\",\n\t}\n\tfor name, content := range cases {\n\t\tt.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\tcode, stdout, _ := runWith(t, content)\n\t\t\tif code != exitRejected {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitRejected)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stdout has %d bytes, want none\", stdout.Len())\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunUsageErrorExitsTwoWithEmptyStdout(t *testing.T) {\n\tpath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"input.csv\")\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(\"a,b\\n1,2\\n\"), 0o600); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"write input: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tcases := map[string][]string{\n\t\t\"no arguments\":      {},\n\t\t\"option after file\": {path, \"--column\", \"a\"},\n\t\t\"unknown option\":    {\"--frobnicate\", path},\n\t}\n\tfor name, args := range cases {\n\t\tt.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\tcode, stdout, _ := runArgs(t, args...)\n\t\t\tif code != exitUsage {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitUsage)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stdout has %d bytes, want none\", stdout.Len())\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunMissingFileExitsOne(t *testing.T) {\n\tmissing := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"absent.csv\")\n\tcode, stdout, _ := runArgs(t, missing)\n\tif code != exitOperational {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitOperational)\n\t}\n\tif stdout.Len() != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stdout has %d bytes, want none\", stdout.Len())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRunValidFormsAreNotUsageErrors(t *testing.T) {\n\tpath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), \"input.csv\")\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(\"a,b\\n1,2\\n\"), 0o600); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"write input: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tforms := [][]string{\n\t\t{path},\n\t\t{\"--column\", \"a\", path},\n\t\t{\"--freq\", \"a\", path},\n\t\t{\"--freq\", \"a\", \"--top\", \"3\", path},\n\t}\n\tfor _, form := range forms {\n\t\tif code, _, _ := runArgs(t, form...); code == exitUsage {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Run(%q) exit code = %d, want non-usage\", form, code)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/cli/doc.go\n// Package cli parses arguments, dispatches commands, maps failures to exit\n// codes, and writes diagnostics to standard error.\npackage cli\n=== internal/csvdata/doc.go\n// Package csvdata reads CSV input, trims fields, recognizes null spellings, and\n// rejects malformed input.\npackage csvdata\n=== internal/csvdata/null.go\npackage csvdata\n\nimport \"strings\"\n\n// IsNull reports whether value, already trimmed of leading and trailing spaces,\n// is a null spelling: empty, or NA, N/A or NULL ignoring case. No other token\n// is null.\nfunc IsNull(value string) bool {\n\treturn value == \"\" ||\n\t\tstrings.EqualFold(value, \"NA\") ||\n\t\tstrings.EqualFold(value, \"N/A\") ||\n\t\tstrings.EqualFold(value, \"NULL\")\n}\n=== internal/csvdata/null_test.go\npackage csvdata\n\nimport \"testing\"\n\nfunc TestIsNullEmpty(t *testing.T) {\n\tif !IsNull(\"\") {\n\t\tt.Fatal(`IsNull(\"\") = false, want true`)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestIsNullSpellings(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, value := range []string{\"NA\", \"na\", \"Na\", \"N/A\", \"n/a\", \"NULL\", \"null\", \"Null\"} {\n\t\tif !IsNull(value) {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"IsNull(%q) = false, want true\", value)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestIsNullNonNullValues(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, value := range []string{\"0\", \"false\", \"NAN\", \"N/B\", \"NULLS\", \"NA1\", \"N A\", \"nil\", \"none\", \"-\"} {\n\t\tif IsNull(value) {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"IsNull(%q) = true, want false\", value)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestQuotedEmptyFieldIsNull(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n\\\"\\\",x\\n\")\n\n\tif !IsNull(table.Records[0].Fields[0]) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"quoted empty field %q is not null\", table.Records[0].Fields[0])\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestSpacesOnlyFieldIsNull(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n   ,x\\n\")\n\tTrim(table)\n\n\tif !IsNull(table.Records[0].Fields[0]) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"spaces-only field %q is not null after trimming\", table.Records[0].Fields[0])\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/csvdata/read.go\npackage csvdata\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/csv\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"io\"\n)\n\n// Record is one data record and the 1-based source line on which it starts.\ntype Record struct {\n\tLine   int\n\tFields []string\n}\n\n// Table is a parsed CSV input: the header record and the data records after it.\ntype Table struct {\n\tHeader  []string\n\tRecords []Record\n}\n\n// Read parses r as RFC 4180 CSV. The first record is the header and every later\n// record is a data record. Values are returned as parsed, untrimmed. Input with\n// no record returns a nil Header and no error; Validate rejects it.\nfunc Read(r io.Reader) (*Table, error) {\n\tcr := csv.NewReader(r)\n\tcr.FieldsPerRecord = -1\n\tcr.LazyQuotes = false\n\n\tvar t Table\n\theader, err := cr.Read()\n\tif err == io.EOF {\n\t\treturn &t, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"read csv: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tt.Header = header\n\n\tfor {\n\t\tfields, err := cr.Read()\n\t\tif err == io.EOF {\n\t\t\treturn &t, nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"read csv: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tline, _ := cr.FieldPos(0)\n\t\tt.Records = append(t.Records, Record{Line: line, Fields: fields})\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/csvdata/read_test.go\npackage csvdata\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/csv\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\nfunc mustRead(t *testing.T, input string) *Table {\n\tt.Helper()\n\ttable, err := Read(strings.NewReader(input))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Read(%q): unexpected error: %v\", input, err)\n\t}\n\treturn table\n}\n\nfunc TestReadHeaderAndRecords(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"name,qty\\nwidget,2\\ngadget,5\\n\")\n\n\tif want := []string{\"name\", \"qty\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Header, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Header = %q, want %q\", table.Header, want)\n\t}\n\tgot := make([][]string, len(table.Records))\n\tfor i, rec := range table.Records {\n\t\tgot[i] = rec.Fields\n\t}\n\twant := [][]string{{\"widget\", \"2\"}, {\"gadget\", \"5\"}}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"record fields = %q, want %q\", got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadQuotedComma(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"name,note\\n\\\"Smith, J\\\",ok\\n\")\n\n\tif len(table.Records) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %d records, want 1\", len(table.Records))\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"Smith, J\", \"ok\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Records[0].Fields, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Fields = %q, want %q\", table.Records[0].Fields, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadTrailingNewline(t *testing.T) {\n\twithNewline := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n1,2\\n\")\n\twithoutNewline := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n1,2\")\n\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(withNewline, withoutNewline) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"with newline = %+v, without = %+v; want equal\", withNewline, withoutNewline)\n\t}\n\tif len(withNewline.Records) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %d records, want 1\", len(withNewline.Records))\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadRecordLineNumbers(t *testing.T) {\n\t// The first data record starts on line 2 and spans lines 2-3 through the\n\t// quoted newline; the next record starts on line 4.\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n1,\\\"multi\\nline\\\"\\n3,4\\n\")\n\n\tlines := make([]int, len(table.Records))\n\tfor i, rec := range table.Records {\n\t\tlines[i] = rec.Line\n\t}\n\tif want := []int{2, 4}; !reflect.DeepEqual(lines, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"record lines = %v, want %v\", lines, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadHeaderOnly(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, input := range []string{\"a,b\\n\", \"a,b\"} {\n\t\ttable := mustRead(t, input)\n\t\tif want := []string{\"a\", \"b\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Header, want) {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Read(%q) Header = %q, want %q\", input, table.Header, want)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif len(table.Records) != 0 {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Read(%q) got %d records, want 0\", input, len(table.Records))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadNoRecords(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, input := range []string{\"\", \"\\n\\n\\n\"} {\n\t\ttable := mustRead(t, input)\n\t\tif table.Header != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Read(%q) Header = %q, want nil\", input, table.Header)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif len(table.Records) != 0 {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Read(%q) got %d records, want 0\", input, len(table.Records))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReadBareQuoteReportsParseError(t *testing.T) {\n\t_, err := Read(strings.NewReader(\"a,b\\n1\\\"x,2\\n\"))\n\n\tvar parseErr *csv.ParseError\n\tif !errors.As(err, &parseErr) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Read error = %v, want a *csv.ParseError\", err)\n\t}\n\tif parseErr.Line != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ParseError.Line = %d, want 2\", parseErr.Line)\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/csvdata/trim.go\npackage csvdata\n\nimport \"strings\"\n\n// Trim removes leading and trailing spaces (U+0020) from every header name and\n// every record field, in place. Other whitespace and interior spaces are kept.\n// Line numbers and field counts are unchanged.\nfunc Trim(t *Table) {\n\tfor i, name := range t.Header {\n\t\tt.Header[i] = strings.Trim(name, \" \")\n\t}\n\tfor r := range t.Records {\n\t\tfields := t.Records[r].Fields\n\t\tfor i, value := range fields {\n\t\t\tfields[i] = strings.Trim(value, \" \")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/csvdata/trim_test.go\npackage csvdata\n\nimport (\n\t\"reflect\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\nfunc TestTrimHeaderNames(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"  name ,  qty\\n1,2\\n\")\n\tTrim(table)\n\n\tif want := []string{\"name\", \"qty\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Header, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Header = %q, want %q\", table.Header, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestTrimValues(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n  Globex  , Acme Corp \\n\")\n\tTrim(table)\n\n\tif want := []string{\"Globex\", \"Acme Corp\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Records[0].Fields, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Fields = %q, want %q\", table.Records[0].Fields, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestTrimQuotedPadding(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"a\\n\\\"  Acme, Inc.  \\\"\\n\")\n\tTrim(table)\n\n\tif want := []string{\"Acme, Inc.\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Header, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Header = %q, want %q\", table.Header, want)\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"\\tv w\\t\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(table.Records[0].Fields, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Fields = %q, want %q\", table.Records[0].Fields, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestTrimKeepsLines(t *testing.T) {\n\ttable := mustRead(t, \"a,b\\n x , y \\n\\\"p\\nq\\\", z\\n\")\n\tbeforeLines := []int{table.Records[0].Line, table.Records[1].Line}\n\tbeforeCounts := []int{len(table.Records[0].Fields), len(table.Records[1].Fields)}\n\n\tTrim(table)\n\n\tafterLines := []int{table.Records[0].Line, table.Records[1].Line}\n\tafterCounts := []int{len(table.Records[0].Fields), len(table.Records[1].Fields)}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(afterLines, beforeLines) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"record lines = %v after Trim, want %v\", afterLines, beforeLines)\n\t}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(afterCounts, beforeCounts) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"field counts = %v after Trim, want %v\", afterCounts, beforeCounts)\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/csvdata/validate.go\npackage csvdata\n\nimport (\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n)\n\n// ErrRejected matches every input rejection with errors.Is.\nvar ErrRejected = errors.New(\"input rejected\")\n\n// RejectedError describes why an input was rejected. Line is the 1-based source\n// line of the offending record, or 0 when the rejection concerns the header or\n// the whole input.\ntype RejectedError struct {\n\tLine   int\n\tReason string\n}\n\nfunc (e *RejectedError) Error() string {\n\tif e.Line == 0 {\n\t\treturn e.Reason\n\t}\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"line %d: %s\", e.Line, e.Reason)\n}\n\n// Unwrap makes errors.Is(err, ErrRejected) true for every RejectedError.\nfunc (e *RejectedError) Unwrap() error {\n\treturn ErrRejected\n}\n\n// Validate rejects input that must produce no output: no header record (empty\n// or blank-only input), an empty or repeated header name, and any record whose\n// field count differs from the header. Call it after Trim, so names compare as\n// trimmed. A header-only table is valid.\nfunc Validate(t *Table) error {\n\tif t.Header == nil {\n\t\treturn &RejectedError{Reason: \"no header record: input is empty or blank\"}\n\t}\n\n\tseen := make(map[string]bool, len(t.Header))\n\tfor i, name := range t.Header {\n\t\tif name == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn &RejectedError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(\"header column %d is empty\", i+1)}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif seen[name] {\n\t\t\treturn &RejectedError{Reason: fmt.Sprintf(\"header name %q is repeated\", name)}\n\t\t}\n\t\tseen[name] = true\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, rec := range t.Records {\n\t\tif len(rec.Fields) != len(t.Header) {\n\t\t\treturn &RejectedError{\n\t\t\t\tLine:   rec.Line,\n\t\t\t\tReason: fmt.Sprintf(\"record has %d fields, header has %d\", len(rec.Fields), len(t.Header)),\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n=== internal/csvdata/validate_test.go\npackage csvdata\n\nimport (\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\n// checkInput runs the same pipeline the cli uses: Read, Trim, Validate.\nfunc checkInput(t *testing.T, input string) error {\n\tt.Helper()\n\ttable, err := Read(strings.NewReader(input))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tTrim(table)\n\treturn Validate(table)\n}\n\nfunc TestRejectEmptyFile(t *testing.T) {\n\tif err := checkInput(t, \"\"); !errors.Is(err, ErrRejected) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"empty file error = %v, want ErrRejected\", err)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRejectBlankLinesOnly(t *testing.T) {\n\tif err := checkInput(t, \"\\n\\n\\n\"); !errors.Is(err, ErrRejected) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"blank-lines-only error = %v, want ErrRejected\", err)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRejectEmptyHeaderName(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, input := range []string{\"id,,name\\n1,x,y\\n\", \"id,  ,name\\n1,x,y\\n\"} {\n\t\tif err := checkInput(t, input); !errors.Is(err, ErrRejected) {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"checkInput(%q) error = %v, want ErrRejected\", input, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRejectRepeatedHeaderName(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, input := range []string{\"id,name,id\\n1,x,2\\n\", \"id, name ,name\\n1,x,2\\n\"} {\n\t\tif err := checkInput(t, input); !errors.Is(err, ErrRejected) {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"checkInput(%q) error = %v, want ErrRejected\", input, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRepeatedHeaderNameIsCaseSensitive(t *testing.T) {\n\tif err := checkInput(t, \"id,name,ID\\n1,x,2\\n\"); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"distinct-case headers rejected: %v\", err)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRejectRaggedRecord(t *testing.T) {\n\terr := checkInput(t, \"a,b\\n1,2\\n3,4,5\\n6,7\\n\")\n\n\tif !errors.Is(err, ErrRejected) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ragged record error = %v, want ErrRejected\", err)\n\t}\n\tvar rejected *RejectedError\n\tif !errors.As(err, &rejected) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"ragged record error = %v, want *RejectedError\", err)\n\t}\n\tif rejected.Line != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"RejectedError.Line = %d, want 3\", rejected.Line)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestHeaderOnlyFileAccepted(t *testing.T) {\n\tif err := checkInput(t, \"a,b\\n\"); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"header-only file rejected: %v\", err)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestTrailingNewlineAddsNoRecord(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, input := range []string{\"a,b\\n1,2\\n\", \"a,b\\n1,2\"} {\n\t\tif err := checkInput(t, input); err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"checkInput(%q) rejected: %v\", input, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\ttable := mustRead(t, input)\n\t\tif len(table.Records) != 1 {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Read(%q) got %d records, want 1\", input, len(table.Records))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n=== internal/profile/doc.go\n// Package profile infers column types and computes counts, extremes, sums,\n// means, and medians with exact arithmetic.\npackage profile\n=== internal/profile/infer.go\npackage profile\n\nimport (\n\t\"regexp\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"time\"\n\n\t\"csvstat/internal/csvdata\"\n)\n\n// Column type names, in the order InferType tests them.\nconst (\n\tTypeEmpty   = \"empty\"\n\tTypeInteger = \"integer\"\n\tTypeNumber  = \"number\"\n\tTypeDate    = \"date\"\n\tTypeBoolean = \"boolean\"\n\tTypeText    = \"text\"\n)\n\nvar (\n\tintegerPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^-?[0-9]+$`)\n\tnumberPattern  = regexp.MustCompile(`^-?[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$`)\n\tdatePattern    = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`)\n)\n\n// InferType returns the type of one column from its trimmed values. Null values\n// are ignored. The first type in the order empty, integer, number, date,\n// boolean, text that the non-null values all satisfy is returned. Classification\n// never uses float parsing and never rewrites a value.\nfunc InferType(values []string) string {\n\tvar present []string\n\tfor _, value := range values {\n\t\tif !csvdata.IsNull(value) {\n\t\t\tpresent = append(present, value)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tswitch {\n\tcase len(present) == 0:\n\t\treturn TypeEmpty\n\tcase allMatch(present, integerPattern.MatchString):\n\t\treturn TypeInteger\n\tcase allMatch(present, numberPattern.MatchString):\n\t\treturn TypeNumber\n\tcase allMatch(present, isDate):\n\t\treturn TypeDate\n\tcase allMatch(present, isBoolean):\n\t\treturn TypeBoolean\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn TypeText\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc allMatch(values []string, match func(string) bool) bool {\n\tfor _, value := range values {\n\t\tif !match(value) {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// isDate requires the YYYY-MM-DD shape and a real calendar date.\nfunc isDate(value string) bool {\n\tif {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_012WVuFZSwZRW3RtHPncePgz","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CsvStat/runs/20261025.051314/build/CsvStat/internal/profile/sum.go (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c1e85a38-e288-4ddb-b8c4-9c189836a82e","uuid":"1e206630-bf61-48c6-99d5-500bc93975f5","timestamp":"2026-10-25T05:41:47.983Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"create","filePath":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CsvStat/runs/20261025.051314/build/CsvStat/internal/profile/sum.go","content":"package profile\n\nimport \"math/big\"\n\n// SumMean takes the column type and the trimmed non-null values of the column. ok is false when\n// the type is not integer or number, or when there are no values.\nfunc SumMean(typ string, values []string) (sum, mean *big.Rat, ok bool) {\n\tif !isNumeric(typ) {\n\t\treturn nil, nil, false\n\t}\n\trats, ok := parseRats(nonNull(values))\n\tif !ok || len(rats) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil, nil, false\n\t}\n\tsum = new(big.Rat)\n\tfor _, rat := range rats {\n\t\tsum.Add(sum, rat)\n\t}\n\tcount := new(big.Rat).SetInt64(int64(len(rats)))\n\tmean = new(big.Rat).Quo(sum, count)\n\treturn sum, mean, true\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_012WVuFZSwZRW3RtHPncePgz","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

Null values are ignored.\n// Integer extremes are plain integers; number extremes keep their source text and carry exact\n// values in MinRat and MaxRat. Date text orders chronologically because it is fixed-width\n// YYYY-MM-DD, and text orders by byte value.\nfunc MinMax(typ string, values []string) Extremes {\n\tpresent := nonNull(values)\n\tif len(present) == 0 {\n\t\treturn Extremes{}\n\t}\n\tswitch typ {\n\tcase TypeInteger, TypeNumber:\n\t\treturn numericExtremes(typ, present)\n\tcase TypeDate, TypeText:\n\t\tlo, hi := present[0], present[0]\n\t\tfor _, value := range present[1:] {\n\t\t\tif value < lo {\n\t\t\t\tlo = value\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif value > hi {\n\t\t\t\thi = value\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn Extremes{Min: lo, Max: hi}\n\tcase TypeBoolean:\n\t\treturn booleanExtremes(present)\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn Extremes{}\n\t}\n}\n\n// numericExtremes compares the values exactly as big.Rat. Integer extremes are rewritten as plain\n// integers; number extremes keep the source text of the extreme value.\nfunc numericExtremes(typ string, values []string) Extremes {\n\trats, ok := parseRats(values)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn Extremes{}\n\t}\n\tlo, hi := 0, 0\n\tfor i := range rats {\n\t\tif rats[i].Cmp(rats[lo]) < 0 {\n\t\t\tlo = i\n\t\t}\n\t\tif rats[i].Cmp(rats[hi]) > 0 {\n\t\t\thi = i\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tresult := Extremes{Min: values[lo], Max: values[hi], MinRat: rats[lo], MaxRat: rats[hi]}\n\tif typ == TypeInteger {\n\t\tresult.Min = FormatInteger(rats[lo])\n\t\tresult.Max = FormatInteger(rats[hi])\n\t}\n\treturn result\n}\n\n// booleanExtremes reports false as the minimum if any value is false, else true; and true as the\n// maximum if any value is true, else false. got != wantSum {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"sum = %s, want %s\", got, wantSum)\n\t}\n\tif got := mean.RatString(); got != wantMean {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"mean = %s, want %s\", got, wantMean)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestSumIntegerExact(t *testing.T) {\n\t// The total exceeds float64 precision, and includes negatives.\n\twantSumMean(t, TypeInteger,\n\t\t[]string{\"-5\", \"10\", \"25\", \"1000000000000000000000\"},\n\t\t\"1000000000000000000030\", \"500000000000000000007.5\")\n}\n\nfunc TestSumNumberNoFloatDrift(t *testing.T) {\n\t// In float64, 0.1 + 0.2 is not 0.3; exactly it is three tenths.\n\twantSumMean(t, TypeNumber, []string{\"0.1\", \"0.2\"}, \"3/10\", \"3/20\")\n}\n\nfunc TestMeanExactRational(t *testing.T) {\n\twantSumMean(t, TypeInteger, []string{\"1\", \"1\", \"2\"}, \"4\", \"4/3\")\n}\n\nfunc TestSumMeanIgnoresNulls(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Two non-null values: the divisor is 2, not the row count of 5.\n\twantSumMean(t, TypeInteger, []string{\"2\", \"NA\", \"\", \"4\", \"null\"}, \"6\", \"3\")\n}\n\nfunc TestSumMeanNonNumeric(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, typ := range []string{TypeText, TypeDate, TypeBoolean, TypeEmpty} {\n\t\tif _, _, ok := SumMean(typ, []string{\"1\", \"2\"}); ok {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"SumMean(%q) ok = true, want false\", typ)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestSumMeanNoNonNullValues(t *testing.T) {\n\tif _, _, ok := SumMean(TypeInteger, []string{\"NA\", \"\"}); ok {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"SumMean with only nulls ok = true, want false\")\n\t}\n\tif _, _, ok := SumMean(TypeInteger, nil); ok {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"SumMean with no values ok = true, want false\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestSumMeanRejectsNonDecimalText(t *testing.T) {\n\t// A fraction form parses as big.Rat but is not a decimal number.\n\tif _, _, ok := SumMean(TypeNumber, []string{\"1/2\"}); ok {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"SumMean(\\\"1/2\\\") ok = true, want false\")\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_016VNGLH51SjqeRL8aX2dpH2","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

got != want {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"Median(%q) = %s, want %s\", values, got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMedianOddCount(t *testing.T) {\n\twantMedian(t, TypeInteger, []string{\"5\", \"1\", \"3\"}, \"3\")\n}\n\nfunc TestMedianEvenCountExact(t *testing.T) {\n\t// The mean of 0.1 and 0.2 is 3/20, which has no exact binary float form.\n\twantMedian(t, TypeNumber, []string{\"0.1\", \"0.2\"}, \"3/20\")\n\twantMedian(t, TypeInteger, []string{\"1\", \"2\", \"3\", \"4\"}, \"5/2\")\n}\n\nfunc TestMedianNumericOrder(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Lexically sorted this is -3, 10, 2, 9 and would give 6; ok {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Median(%q) ok = true, want false\", typ)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif _, ok := Median(TypeInteger, []string{\"NA\"}); ok {\n\t\tt.Error(\"Median with only nulls ok = true, want false\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMedianDoesNotReorderInput(t *testing.T) {\n\tvalues := []string{\"3\", \"1\", \"2\"}\n\tMedian(TypeInteger, values)\n\tif want := []string{\"3\", \"1\", \"2\"}; numerically the middle pair is 2 and 9.\n\twantMedian(t, TypeInteger, []string{\"10\", \"9\", \"-3\", \"2\"}, \"11/2\")\n}\n\nfunc TestMedianIgnoresNulls(t *testing.T) {\n\twantMedian(t, TypeInteger, []string{\"1\", \"NA\", \"3\", \"\", \"5\"}, \"3\")\n}\n\nfunc TestMedianNonNumeric(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, typ := range []string{TypeText, TypeDate, TypeBoolean, TypeEmpty} {\n\t\tif _, ok := Median(typ, []string{\"1\", \"2\", \"3\"}); ok {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"Median(%q) ok = true, want false\", typ)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif _, ok := Median(TypeInteger, []string{\"NA\"}); ok {\n\t\tt.Error(\"Median with only nulls ok = true, want false\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMedianDoesNotReorderInput(t *testing.T) {\n\tvalues := []string{\"3\", \"1\", \"2\"}\n\tMedian(TypeInteger, values)\n\tif want := []string{\"3\", \"1\", \"2\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(values, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"input reordered to %q, want %q\", values, want)\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_0114mMfh1GnE7umAiEAV5k9Q","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{\n\tgot := expectExtremes(t, TypeInteger, []string{\"10\", \"9\", \"-3\", \"100\"}, \"-3\", \"100\")\n\tif got.MinRat == nil || got.MaxRat == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"integer extremes have nil exact want -1/2, 41/4\", got.MinRat.RatString(), got.MaxRat.RatString())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxDate(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectExtremes(t, TypeDate, []string{\"2025-01-31\", \"2019-12-01\", \"2024-02-29\"}, \"2019-12-01\", \"2025-01-31\")\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxBoolean(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := []struct {\n\t\tname     string\n\t\tvalues   []string\n\t\tmin, max string\n\t}{\n\t\t{\"mixed case\", []string{\"TRUE\", \"false\", \"True\"}, \"false\", \"true\"},\n\t\t{\"all true\", []string{\"TRUE\", \"True\"}, \"true\", \"true\"},\n\t\t{\"all false\", []string{\"false\", \"FALSE\"}, \"false\", \"false\"},\n\t\t{\"mixed\", []string{\"False\", \"true\"}, \"false\", \"true\"},\n\t}\n\tfor _, c := range cases {\n\t\tt.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\texpectExtremes(t, TypeBoolean, c.values, c.min, c.max)\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxText(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Byte order: upper case before lower case, space before letters, \"apple\" before \"apple2\".\n\texpectExtremes(t, TypeText, []string{\"apple\", \"Banana\", \"a b\", \"Zed\", \"apple2\"}, \"Banana\", \"apple2\")\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxEmpty(t *testing.T) {\n\tgot := expectExtremes(t, TypeEmpty, []string{\"NA\", \"\"}, \"\", \"\")\n\tif got.MinRat != nil || got.MaxRat != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"empty extremes have exact values: %+v\", got)\n\t}\n\texpectExtremes(t, TypeEmpty, nil, \"\", \"\")\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxSingleValue(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectExtremes(t, TypeInteger, []string{\"NA\", \"7\"}, \"7\", \"7\")\n}\n\nfunc TestMinMaxIntegerLargeExact(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Beyond float64 precision the two values differ only in the last digit.\n\texpectExtremes(t, TypeInteger, []string{\"9007199254740993\", \"9007199254740992\"},\n\t\t\"9007199254740992\", \"9007199254740993\")\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01HsMBPeDAT8d7kJHCvRhwiv","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

got != want {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"FormatDecimal(%s) = %q, want %q\", literal, got, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestFormatDecimalTwoPlaces(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"3\", \"3.00\")\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"1.5\", \"1.50\")\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"0\", \"0.00\")\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"1.23456\", \"1.23\")\n}\n\nfunc TestFormatDecimalHalfAwayFromZero(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"0.005\", \"0.01\")\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"-0.005\", \"-0.01\")\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"0.125\", \"0.13\")\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"-0.125\", \"-0.13\")\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"2.345\", \"2.35\")\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"1.004\", \"1.00\")\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"1.005\", \"1.01\")\n}\n\nfunc TestFormatDecimalNoNegativeZero(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"-0.001\", \"0.00\")\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"-0.004\", \"0.00\")\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"-0\", \"0.00\")\n}\n\nfunc TestFormatDecimalNoSeparator(t *testing.T) {\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"1234.5\", \"1234.50\")\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"1234567.891\", \"1234567.89\")\n}\n\nfunc TestFormatDecimalLargeExact(t *testing.T) {\n\t// The tie at the third decimal rounds up, keeping every digit of a value that float64 cannot hold.\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"12345678901234567890.125\", \"12345678901234567890.13\")\n\texpectDecimal(t, \"-900719925474099312.345\", \"-900719925474099312.35\")\n}\n\nfunc TestFormatInteger(t *testing.T) {\n\tcases := map[string]string{\n\t\t\"0\":       \"0\",\n\t\t\"-0\":      \"0\",\n\t\t\"-42\":     \"-42\",\n\t\t\"1234567\": \"1234567\",\n\t}\n\tfor literal, want := range cases {\n\t\tif got := FormatInteger(rat(t, literal)); rows\n}\n\n// profileOf runs the default invocation on content and returns the parsed rows.\nfunc profileOf(t *testing.T, content string) [][]string {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tcode, stdout, _ := runWith(t, content)\n\tif code != exitOK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitOK)\n\t}\n\treturn parseOutput(t, stdout)\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileHeaderAndColumnOrder(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"id,label,price\\n1,a,1.50\\n2,b,2.25\\n4,c,3.00\\n\")\n\n\twantHeader := []string{\"column\", \"type\", \"rows\", \"nulls\", \"distinct\", \"min\", \"max\", \"sum\", \"mean\", \"median\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rows[0], wantHeader) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"header = %q, want %q\", rows[0], wantHeader)\n\t}\n\tvar names, types []string\n\tfor _, row := range rows[1:] {\n\t\tnames = append(names, row[0])\n\t\ttypes = append(types, row[1])\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"id\", \"label\", \"price\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(names, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"columns = %q, want %q\", names, want)\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"integer\", \"text\", \"number\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(types, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"types = %q, want %q\", types, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileIntegerRow(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"id,label,price\\n1,a,1.50\\n2,b,2.25\\n4,c,3.00\\n\")\n\n\twant := []string{\"id\", \"integer\", \"3\", \"0\", \"3\", \"1\", \"4\", \"7\", \"2.33\", \"2.00\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rows[1], want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"integer row = %q, want %q\", rows[1], want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileNumberRow(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"id,label,price\\n1,a,1.50\\n2,b,2.25\\n4,c,3.00\\n\")\n\n\twant := []string{\"price\", \"number\", \"3\", \"0\", \"3\", \"1.50\", \"3.00\", \"6.75\", \"2.25\", \"2.25\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rows[3], want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"number row = %q, want %q\", rows[3], want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileTextRowHasBlankStatistics(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"id,label,price\\n1,a,1.50\\n2,b,2.25\\n4,c,3.00\\n\")\n\n\twant := []string{\"label\", \"text\", \"3\", \"0\", \"3\", \"a\", \"c\", \"\", \"\", \"\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rows[2], want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"text row = %q, want %q\", rows[2], want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileHeaderOnlyRowsAreEmpty(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"sku,price\\n\")\n\n\tif len(rows) != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %d rows, want header plus 2 columns\", len(rows))\n\t}\n\twant := []string{\"sku\", \"empty\", \"0\", \"0\", \"0\", \"\", \"\", \"\", \"\", \"\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rows[1], want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"header-only row = %q, want %q\", rows[1], want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileQuotedValueRoundTrips(t *testing.T) {\n\t// The value is padded and contains a comma and quotes; the trimmed value must come back intact.\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"note\\n\\\"  x, \\\"\\\"y\\\"\\\"  \\\"\\n\")\n\n\tif got := rows[1][5]; got != `x, \"y\"` {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"min = %q, want %q\", got, `x, \"y\"`)\n\t}\n\tif got := rows[1][6]; got != `x, \"y\"` {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"max = %q, want %q\", got, `x, \"y\"`)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileNumberRoundsHalfAwayOnce(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"pos,neg,tiny\\n0.125,-0.125,0.001\\n0.125,-0.125,-0.002\\n\")\n\n\tif got := rows[1][8]; got != \"0.13\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"pos mean = %q, want 0.13\", got)\n\t}\n\tif got := rows[2][8]; got != \"-0.13\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"neg mean = %q, want -0.13\", got)\n\t}\n\tif got := rows[3][7]; got != \"0.00\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"tiny sum = %q, want 0.00\", got)\n\t}\n\tif got := rows[3][8]; got != \"0.00\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"tiny mean = %q, want 0.00\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileNullsCountedAndExcluded(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"n\\n1\\nNA\\n\\n3\\n\")\n\n\twant := []string{\"n\", \"integer\", \"4\", \"2\", \"2\", \"1\", \"3\", \"4\", \"2.00\", \"2.00\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rows[1], want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"row = %q, want %q\", rows[1], want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileOutputEndsWithNewlineAndHasNoCarriageReturn(t *testing.T) {\n\tcode, stdout, _ := runWith(t, \"a,b\\n1,x\\n2,y\\n\")\n\tif code != exitOK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitOK)\n\t}\n\tif bytes.Contains(stdout.Bytes(), []byte(\"\\r\")) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"output contains a carriage return\")\n\t}\n\tif stdout.Len() == 0 || stdout.Bytes()[stdout.Len()-1] != '\\n' {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"output does not end with a newline\")\n\t}\n\tif rows := the trimmed value must come back intact.\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"note\\n\\\"  x, \\\"\\\"y\\\"\\\"  \\\"\\n\")\n\n\tif got := rows[1][5]; got != `x, \"y\"` {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"min = %q, want %q\", got, `x, \"y\"`)\n\t}\n\tif got := rows[1][6]; !reflect.DeepEqual(names, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"columns = %q, want %q\", names, want)\n\t}\n\tif want := []string{\"integer\", \"text\", \"number\"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(types, want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"types = %q, want %q\", types, want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileIntegerRow(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"id,label,price\\n1,a,1.50\\n2,b,2.25\\n4,c,3.00\\n\")\n\n\twant := []string{\"id\", \"integer\", \"3\", \"0\", \"3\", \"1\", \"4\", \"7\", \"2.33\", \"2.00\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rows[1], want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"integer row = %q, want %q\", rows[1], want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileNumberRow(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"id,label,price\\n1,a,1.50\\n2,b,2.25\\n4,c,3.00\\n\")\n\n\twant := []string{\"price\", \"number\", \"3\", \"0\", \"3\", \"1.50\", \"3.00\", \"6.75\", \"2.25\", \"2.25\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rows[3], want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"number row = %q, want %q\", rows[3], want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileTextRowHasBlankStatistics(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"id,label,price\\n1,a,1.50\\n2,b,2.25\\n4,c,3.00\\n\")\n\n\twant := []string{\"label\", \"text\", \"3\", \"0\", \"3\", \"a\", \"c\", \"\", \"\", \"\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rows[2], want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"text row = %q, want %q\", rows[2], want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileHeaderOnlyRowsAreEmpty(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"sku,price\\n\")\n\n\tif len(rows) != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"got %d rows, want header plus 2 columns\", len(rows))\n\t}\n\twant := []string{\"sku\", \"empty\", \"0\", \"0\", \"0\", \"\", \"\", \"\", \"\", \"\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rows[1], want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"header-only row = %q, want %q\", rows[1], want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileQuotedValueRoundTrips(t *testing.T) {\n\t// The value is padded and contains a comma and quotes; the trimmed value must come back intact.\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"note\\n\\\"  x, \\\"\\\"y\\\"\\\"  \\\"\\n\")\n\n\tif got := rows[1][5]; got != `x, \"y\"` {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"min = %q, want %q\", got, `x, \"y\"`)\n\t}\n\tif got := rows[1][6]; got != `x, \"y\"` {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"max = %q, want %q\", got, `x, \"y\"`)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileNumberRoundsHalfAwayOnce(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"pos,neg,tiny\\n0.125,-0.125,0.001\\n0.125,-0.125,-0.002\\n\")\n\n\tif got := rows[1][8]; got != \"0.13\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"pos mean = %q, want 0.13\", got)\n\t}\n\tif got := rows[2][8]; got != \"-0.13\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"neg mean = %q, want -0.13\", got)\n\t}\n\tif got := rows[3][7]; got != \"0.00\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"tiny sum = %q, want 0.00\", got)\n\t}\n\tif got := rows[3][8]; got != \"0.00\" {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"tiny mean = %q, want 0.00\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileNullsCountedAndExcluded(t *testing.T) {\n\trows := profileOf(t, \"n\\n1\\nNA\\n\\n3\\n\")\n\n\twant := []string{\"n\", \"integer\", \"4\", \"2\", \"2\", \"1\", \"3\", \"4\", \"2.00\", \"2.00\"}\n\tif !reflect.DeepEqual(rows[1], want) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"row = %q, want %q\", rows[1], want)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestProfileOutputEndsWithNewlineAndHasNoCarriageReturn(t *testing.T) {\n\tcode, stdout, _ := runWith(t, \"a,b\\n1,x\\n2,y\\n\")\n\tif code != exitOK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"exit code = %d, want %d\", code, exitOK)\n\t}\n\tif bytes.Contains(stdout.Bytes(), []byte(\"\\r\")) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"output contains a carriage return\")\n\t}\n\tif stdout.Len() == 0 || stdout.Bytes()[stdout.Len()-1] != '\\n' {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"output does not end with a newline\")\n\t}\n\tif rows := parseOutput(t, stdout); got != wantSum {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"sum = %s, want %s\", got, wantSum)\n\t}\n\tif got := mean.RatString(); got != wantMean {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"mean = %s, want %s\", got, wantMean)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestSumIntegerExact(t *testing.T) {\n\t// The total exceeds float64 precision, and includes negatives.\n\twantSumMean(t, TypeInteger,\n\t\t[]string{\"-5\", \"10\", \"25\", \"1000000000000000000000\"},\n\t\t\"1000000000000000000030\", \"500000000000000000007.5\")\n}\n\nfunc TestSumNumberNoFloatDrift(t *testing.T) {\n\t// In float64, 0.1 + 0.2 is not 0.3; exactly it is three tenths.\n\twantSumMean(t, TypeNumber, []string{\"0.1\", \"0.2\"}, \"3/10\", \"3/20\")\n}\n\nfunc TestMeanExactRational(t *testing.T) {\n\twantSumMean(t, TypeInteger, []string{\"1\", \"1\", \"2\"}, \"4\", \"4/3\")\n}\n\nfunc TestSumMeanIgnoresNulls(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Two non-null values: the divisor is 2, not the row count of 5.\n\twantSumMean(t, TypeInteger, []string{\"2\", \"NA\", \"\", \"4\", \"null\"}, \"6\", \"3\")\n}\n\nfunc TestSumMeanNonNumeric(t *testing.T) {\n\tfor _, typ := range []string{TypeText, TypeDate, TypeBoolean, TypeEmpty} {\n\t\tif _, _, ok := SumMean(typ, []string{\"1\", \"2\"}); ok {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"SumMean(%q) ok = true, want false\", typ)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestSumMeanNoNonNullValues(t *testing.T) {\n\tif _, _, ok := SumMean(TypeInteger, []string{\"NA\", \"\"}); ok {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"SumMean with only nulls ok = true, want false\")\n\t}\n\tif _, _, ok := SumMean(TypeInteger, nil); ok {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"SumMean with no values ok = true, want false\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestSumMeanRejectsNonDecimalText(t *testing.T) {\n\t// A fraction form parses as big.Rat but is not a decimal number.\n\tif _, _, ok := SumMean(TypeNumber, []string{\"1/2\"}); {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01AEL4maSuZv6R8fhYVxpDHy","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Run native Go tests and the built Go executable from a Blueprint's Python AC container.\n\nCopied beside each criterion by Drydock. No Drydock installation is needed in the Target.\nThe outer acceptance process owns the timeout and kills the whole process group.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport atexit\nimport json\nimport re\nimport shutil\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nimport tempfile\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GoResult:\n    passed: bool\n    status: str\n    return_code: int | None\n    stdout: str\n    stderr: str\n    tests: dict[str, str]\n\n\ndef _report(result: GoResult) -> GoResult:\n    print(\"DRYDOCK_NATIVE_RESULT=\" + json.dumps({\"status\": result.status}), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)\n    return result\n\n\ndef run_test(package: str, test: str) -> GoResult:\n    \"\"\"Execute one exact test/subtest; absent and skipped tests never pass.\"\"\"\n    if not package.startswith('./') or '..' in package.split('/'):\n        raise ValueError('package must be a relative Go package beneath the build root')\n    if not re.fullmatch(r'Test[A-Za-z0-9_]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_ -]+)*', test):\n        raise ValueError('test must name a Test function, optionally followed by named subtests')\n    pattern = '/'.join('^' + re.escape(part) + '$' for part in test.split('/'))\n    try:\n        process = subprocess.run(\n            ['go', 'test', '-json', '-count=1', '-run', pattern, package],\n            capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace', check=False,\n        )\n    except OSError as exc:\n        return _report(GoResult(False, 'unavailable', None, '', str(exc), {}))\n    tests = {}\n    for line in process.stdout.splitlines():\n        try:\n            event = json.loads(line)\n        except ValueError:\n            continue\n        if event.get('Test') and event.get('Action') in ('pass', 'fail', 'skip'):\n            tests[event.get('Package', '') + '/' + event['Test']] = event['Action']\n    matching = [value for key, value in tests.items() if key.endswith('/' + test)]\n    if process.returncode != 0:\n        status = 'fail' if 'fail' in tests.values() else 'execution-error'\n    elif not matching:\n        status = 'not-run'\n    elif any(value == 'skip' for value in tests.values()):\n        status = 'skip'\n    elif all(value == 'pass' for value in matching):\n        status = 'pass'\n    else:\n        status = 'fail'\n    return _report(GoResult(status == 'pass', status, process.returncode,\n                    process.stdout, process.stderr, tests))\n\n\n_BUILT: dict[str, str] = {}\n\n\ndef _main_package() -> str:\n    \"\"\"The single ``./cmd/<name>`` main package; a criterion names ``package=`` when there are several.\"\"\"\n    found = sorted({\n        path.parent.as_posix()\n        for path in Path('cmd').glob('*/*.go')\n        if re.search(r'^package main\\b', path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'), re.M)\n    })\n    if len(found) != 1:\n        raise ValueError(f'expected one main package under ./cmd, found {found or \"none\"}; pass package=')\n    return './' + found[0]\n\n\ndef _executable(package: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Build ``package`` once per criterion process and return the binary's path.\"\"\"\n    if package in _BUILT:\n        return _BUILT[package]\n    directory = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='drydock-go-cli-')\n    atexit.register(shutil.rmtree, directory, True)\n    binary = str(Path(directory) / Path(package).name)\n    try:\n        build = subprocess.run(\n            ['go', 'build', '-o', binary, package],\n            capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace', check=False,\n        )\n    except OSError as exc:\n        _report(GoResult(False, 'unavailable', None, '', str(exc), {}))\n        raise RuntimeError(f'go is unavailable: {exc}') from exc\n    if build.returncode != 0:\n        _report(GoResult(False, 'execution-error', build.returncode, build.stdout, build.stderr, {}))\n        raise RuntimeError(f'go build {package} failed:\\n{build.stderr}')\n    _BUILT[package] = binary\n    return binary\n\n\ndef cli_runner(*args: str, package: str | None = None, input: str | None = None) -> tuple[int, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Return ``(exit_code, stdout, stderr)`` from the built executable.\n\n    The binary is built with ``go build`` and run directly. ``go run`` is never used: it reports\n    every non-zero program exit as 1, so a criterion could not observe exit 2 or 3 at all.\n    \"\"\"\n    package = package or _main_package()\n    if not package.startswith('./') or '..' in package.split('/'):\n        raise ValueError('package must be a relative Go package beneath the build root')\n    process = subprocess.run(\n        [_executable(package), *args],\n        input=input, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace', check=False,\n    )\n    return process.returncode, process.stdout,
